name: Cape Canaveral, Florida
blurb: A famous, busy coast with lots of launch experience.

name: Kodiak, Alaska
risk: Freezing cold. Hard on rubber seals.
blurb: A chilly island pad far to the north.

name: Kourou, French Guiana
perk: Near the equator, so rockets lift 10% more.
blurb: A jungle coast where Earth's spin gives you a free push.

name: Mahia, New Zealand
perk: Low fees and a quiet pad.
risk: Small pads, so no Pelican. Slow deliveries.
blurb: A quiet peninsula with small pads and big ocean views.

name: Sriharikota, India
blurb: An island pad close enough to the equator for a small boost.
